methods.label: Enumerate the two-coin outcomes
methods.explanation: A table or tree diagram gives 4 equally likely outcomes: (heads, heads), (heads, tails), (tails, heads), and (tails, tails). Only 1 outcome has both coins showing heads, so the probability is \(1/4\).
methods.levelReason: Listing four ordered outcomes and dividing the favorable count by the total count fits grade 9 probability.
